author: Inside Edition
description: Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky went face to face with fellow Senator Markwayne Mullin at the confirmation hearing for the nominee for Homeland Security Secretary Wednesday. Bad blood existed between them after Mullin previously said he understood why Paul was the recipient of a brutal beating he got from a neighbor in 2017. Paul asked Mullin about the comment on Wednesday. Mullin did not apologize. Mullin said he hoped the two of them could put aside their personal animosity.
title: Sen. Rand Paul Confronts Sen. Markwayne Mullin At Hearing

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect jumped into a river during a police pursuit, prompting cops to chase him on paddle boards. When they reached the 26-year-old suspect, he struggled to stay afloat. The deputy sheriffs handcuffed the suspect to a floatation device while he was still in the water, then wrapped a second device around his waist. The suspect was later charged with loitering. In a separate incident, a police officer jumped on the hood of a passing car while chasing a suspect.
title: Florida Sheriffs Use Paddleboards To Chase Suspect

author: Inside Edition
description: Former "Baywatch" star Alexandra Paul says she is on a mission to rescue beagles from a dog breeding facility outside Madison, Wisconsin. She was one of a hundred activists forming an alleged puppy mill, and 27 protestors were arrested for trespassing, including Paul. She spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano. The release of her mugshot comes as filming for the "Baywatch" reboot gets underway in Los Angeles.
title: 'Baywatch' Star Alexandra Paul Speaks Out After Her Arrest

author: Inside Edition
description: Vhan McGuire says he has an average life for a college student, but in October 2024, a motorcycle accident caused him to lose the ability to take part in some of his favorite activities. He became paralyzed and wasn't able to go camping, hiking, or do other outdoor activities. Then one day he says a friend introduced him to a group of students at Tennessee Tech looking for a challenging project to take on. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: College Students' Project Help Paralyzed Man Reclaim Love Of The Outdoors
